activity.notes: René became President after the 5 June 1977 coup and remained head of state through the one-party period and the later restored multiparty system, handing the presidency to James Michel in July 2004.

sources.title: History of the National Assembly
sources.citation_text: The National Assembly of Seychelles records France Albert René as Prime Minister at independence, the June 1977 overthrow of President Mancham, and René's 27-year presidency ending with handover in 2004.

sources.title: France-Albert René
sources.citation_text: The standard office chronology records René as Prime Minister from 29 June 1976 to 5 June 1977 and President from 5 June 1977 to 14 July 2004.
